name: Greece
startIntroPart2: Although, Ellada will be great again.
declaringWar: Resistance is futile! Prepare to be assimilated!

defeated: You may have defeated us, but what we leave behind is woven into the lives of others.

hateHello: What matter that you would bother us with, now?
hateNo: We are not agreeing to that!
hateYes: Know that we made a choice out of spite.
afterPeace: I forebobe, you are likely to come back for another round.
tradeRequest: We bestow you the honor of this trade offer.
